final: WITH p AS (SELECT pl.player_id, pl.bats, AVG(b."double") AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason b JOIN player pl ON pl.player_id = b.player_id GROUP BY pl.player_id, pl.bats), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) AS overall FROM p), idx AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.bats, p.avg_doubles, p.avg_doubles / o.overall AS idx FROM p, o), h AS (SELECT idx.*, AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS hand_avg FROM idx) SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx AS index_value, idx - hand_avg AS diff_from_hand_avg FROM h WHERE bats IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_hand_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
